description: Registry template for registering Firefox Portable as a current-user browser candidate in Windows Default Apps.
notes: This is a registry template, not a self-contained application. Running `firefox-portable-registration` opens it in Notepad; replace every `c:\path\to\firefox-portable.exe` placeholder with the real portable launcher path before importing it.

Review the template before importing: it includes file associations and URL protocols, including mailto. Do not merge it unchanged. Windows 11 may still require the user to choose Firefox Portable from Settings > Apps > Default Apps; UCPD-protected defaults are not forced by this template.
